verdict.rationale: Smithery did ship an official CLI. Its GitHub repo documents commands for searching the registry, adding MCP connections, and finding and calling tools. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says the CLI stopped working on October 31, 2026 and current versions are deprecated, so the capability exists only as a defunct tool. Missing for 10: a currently functional CLI, maintained docs (the docs tree is removed), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: smithery mcp search [term]              # Search the Smithery registry
smithery tool call <connection> <tool> [args]  # Call a tool
"The Smithery CLI and SDKs", with current versions marked deprecated
